items.title: Publishing LMS courses with a Kiro SCORM pipeline
items.summary: See how to use Kiro, an agentic AI, to automate converting raw training material into compliant SCORM packages that are ready to upload to a learning management system (LMS).
items.creator: Omar Gonzalez

items.title: Vessel-specific voyage optimization with machine learning: Manta on AWS
items.summary: Manta Marine Technologies closes the gap between seemingly identical ships by training machine learning models on each vessel's own operational history. Learn how Manta delivers vessel-specific voyage optimization on AWS to help shipowners reduce fuel consumption and improve voyage efficiency.
items.creator: Borja Rojo

items.title: How Anchorage Digital and Turnkey verify code with AWS Nitro Enclaves
items.summary: Anchorage Digital and Turnkey built verifiable infrastructure on AWS Nitro Enclaves so crypto wallets can cryptographically verify which code parsed a transaction. This post covers the architecture, the attestation-gated access pattern, and how it extends to any high-trust workflow beyond blockchain.
items.creator: Alexander Qin
